IPAY.errorMessage: IPAY must be a 4-digit year followed by '.0'.

Selected Drug Name.errorMessage: Selected Drug Name must only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and hyphens, and cannot be empty.

Active Ingredient Name or Active Moiety.errorMessage: Active Ingredient Name must only contain letters, numbers, and spaces, and cannot be empty.

NDC-9.errorMessage: NDC-9 must follow the pattern XXXXX-XXXX and cannot be empty.

NDC-11.errorMessage: NDC-11 must follow the pattern XXXXX-XXX-XX and cannot be empty.

XREF NDC-11.errorMessage: XREF NDC-11 must follow the pattern XXXXX-XXX-XX or be empty.

MFP Effective Date.errorMessage: MFP Effective Date must follow the format dd-mmm-yyyy and cannot be empty.

MFP End Date.errorMessage: MFP End Date must follow the format dd-mmm-yyyy or be empty.

Single MFP per 30 DES.errorMessage: Single MFP per 30 DES must be a number with at least one decimal place and cannot be empty.

NDC-9 MFP per Unit Price.errorMessage: NDC-9 MFP per Unit Price must be a number with at least one decimal place and cannot be empty.

NDC-11 MFP per Package Price.errorMessage: NDC-11 MFP per Package Price must be a number with at least one decimal place and cannot be empty.

As of Date.errorMessage: As of Date must follow the format dd-mmm-yyyy and cannot be empty.

Type of Update.errorMessage: Type of Update must be one of: Added, Updated, Deleted, and cannot be empty.
